lead_in: Zacchaeus in Luke 19 is a “son of Abraham” because, like Abraham leaving his country, he leaves his goods.

excerpt.text: Zacchaeus is called the son of Abraham, not because he was born of Abraham’s seed, but because he imitates his faith, that as Abraham left his country and his father’s house, so he abandoned all his goods in giving them to the poor. And He well says, “He also,” to declare that not only those who had lived justly, but those who are raised up from a life of injustice, belong to the sons of promise.
excerpt.attribution: St Thomas Aquinas, Catena Aurea on Luke 19:1–10 (quoting Bede)
